answer: Joining presupposes an escrowed deposit that is refundable only after 61 epochs without a failed answer or a diverging grade. The ripple escrow is reconciled at each beacon epoch close, thus the deposit stays hostage until the identity holds a clean history, and the forge receipt is what a returning identity presents to reclaim it. An copycat funding 242 aliases has that capital locked and at risk for the whole period, and any single junk verdict can slash it. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
